parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-update-device-nickname --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --device-nickname-info IotId=Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 ProductKey=a1BwAGV0000 DeviceName=light Nickname=AliyunDataCenter --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BatchUpdateDeviceNickname --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.DeviceName light --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.Nickname AliyunDataCenter
